method: The decision rests on mission-lifecycle-v1199i (harness 1199i, candidate 1214cy, free camera): only the host is told to load Edge of the World; the client follows natively (join-follow) and the product controller arms every system for the new shared world. The partner avatar must then be present on both peers (probe actor live at the remote player's position, within 1.5 m of its facing spot) and is filmed from both windows. A shared death and native checkpoint restart follows; the partner must be restored and filmed again on both peers. Each wait throws if the partner is missing, so the audit cases (one per observed partner and phase) pass only after both phases. The earlier functional audit is 1286 (mission-lifecycle-v1199h, 1214ap, the same result).

items.scope: The partner avatar in both roles after a native map load (join-follow, product controller) and after a shared death and native checkpoint restart: present, upright and whole in the other window, with its presentation re-armed.

visual.verdict: After the map load Corvo stands upright and whole on the dock in front of the wall posters, idling naturally.
After the map load Emily stands upright and whole on the boat deck beside the pilot, idling naturally.
After the checkpoint restart Corvo is back, upright at the left edge of the frame by the same wall.
After the checkpoint restart Emily is back, upright at the left edge of the frame on the boat.
